info.provider: openai (OpenAI-compatible HTTP) -> scripted ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 (local stub)

checks.check: environment: openminion 0.1.17 imported from site-packages in isolated mode; the provider is the scripted local stub on 127.0.0.1; the example file is the published docs/runtime-surfaces.md (git blob 358abd59...)

item 1: Agent.run returns the thread id (AgentRunResult.thread_id = metadata['thread_id'], non-blank) for a turn whose memory.write call waits; agent.run('yes', thread_id=first.thread_id) resumes that thread in the same session (resume_thread / explicit_thread_requested) and the waiting call runs exactly once, with the model's arguments, writing fact:editor_font; a stale second 'yes' on the thread is resumed but runs nothing

first = agent.run("Remember that I write code in Iosevka 14.")
if first.metadata.get("respond_kind") == "policy_confirmation_prompt":
    # Answer the confirmation on the thread that is waiting for it.
    answer = agent.run("yes", thread_id=first.thread_id)
